showcase.title: FROM THEN AND ON
showcase.description: First artwork created for Evoke Art Collective.
texts: VISION : Since the beginning of the universe, TIME has been flowing like a unstoppable river. Among all the galaxies in the space, there's a small blue planet called EARTH. Same thing on the earth, many millenia has passed along with the rise and falls of different type of beings and civilizations. This artwork focuses on the two of the most powerful beings that have ever lived on the surfaces of the planet. Many seconds, minutes, hours, years, and decades have passed. What will be left behind when it all ends? SOFTWARES USED : Cinema4D, Realflow and Photoshop CC DURATION : ≈ 35 hours with divided sessions over 2 months.
Thank you for your attention. I hope everybody enjoy my first contribution for Evoke Art Collective. HTTP://EVOKEONE.COM

showcase.title: INFINITE WORLDS
showcase.description: A sereis of photograph taken with an iPhone 5 camera. Used VSCO Cam app for most editing.
texts: STORY BEHIND THE PROJECT. Although I am not a professional photographer, I love taking pictures and see the world from a different point of view. In June of 2013, I acquired a set of lens for my iPhone. The set includes a macro lens, which I have used the most for this project. With the help from the lens, I saw what I have been missing or have been ignoring for my whole life. I have been living in a world so big, I have forgotten about the little worlds around me. From dust on a car window to a cluster of moss on a tree trunk, there are so many stories behind them. I hope you enjoy looking at the project. And this is just part one.... -
MATERIALS . 3 in 1 lens for iPhone 5. . VSCO Cam app , Filterstorm Pro app . Piction app (typographic caption series is here .) . Instagram -

showcase.title: Bass
showcase.description: A collab between Me and Nyein Chan Soe.
texts: Bass Collab between Me and Nyein Chan Soe's Photography.

After my first collab with Dario Calonaci, I learnt that you can find new ideas and ways of expressing when you 'collab' with another artist. This time I contacted Nyein Chan Soe, who is pretty famous in my hometown for being a really cool portrait photographer, and he said 'YES!' I already like the lighting he had with the photo so I didnt really touch the part except changing the exposure to bring out more details on the shirt and a shinier hair. The model got an earphone so what came into my mind is the deep bass that I love. I put some vectors and objects that show the explosion and deepness and colorful techno shapes. Hope you like it!
Original photo by Nyein Chan Soe.

showcase.title: Illusions
showcase.description: Collab with Thiha Soul Photography.
texts: Illusion Another Collaboration with an amazing landscape photographer.

Two is better than one. It has always been a phrase that use to say to prove that team play is better than a solo player. A graphic designer like myself cannot survive alone. We need resources to make great art pieces and works. We need amazing stock pictures. And here, Thiha Soel, is a professional landscape photographer. His love for nature and wildness drew my attention and push my designing skills to mix my style with his 'natureness'. It was pretty difficult at first. I couldn't decide what to design. With the help of the internet and books and magazines, I get more inspirations and I finally had the chance to put up with this art piece. You can view amazing photos that are taken by Thiha Soul at http://thihasoul.com Hope you all like it. Cheers.
